title: Knowledge Digester adapter: code repositories
requested_outcome: Context: the Knowledge Digester (docs/product-memory/KNOWLEDGE_DIGESTER_V1.md on the trunk; SOURCE_ASSIMILATION_V1.md) turns any external artifact into provenance-tagged, reversible Units. Its model is in app/digest/model.py in this base commit (Unit with artifact_id, kind from UNIT_KINDS, title, body of at most MAX_BODY characters, a Location of path and line span, and tags). This objective adds one adapter, the stage that decomposes a quarantined artifact into Units. Adapter contract, shared by every adapter: a module in app/digest/adapters/ (a namespace package: do not create app/digest/adapters/__init__.py, sibling objectives add their own adapters there) exposing NAME (a short string), HANDLES (a tuple of plain-word artifact kinds it understands) and decompose(root: Path, artifact_id: str) -> list[Unit], which reads only (never executes, imports or installs anything it reads), bounds file sizes and counts, returns Units in a deterministic order with exact locations, and never raises on malformed input (it skips what it cannot parse and says so in a Unit of kind knowledge tagged 'unparsed' with the reason). Standard library only. Build app/digest/adapters/code.py for source code. Python files are read with the ast module (parsing is reading; nothing is imported or run): each public module, class and function with its signature and docstring becomes a capability Unit when it looks callable from outside (a command-line entry, an exported function) and a pattern Unit otherwise; pyproject and setup.cfg console scripts and argparse or click command definitions become capability Units. JavaScript and TypeScript are read by careful pattern matching: exported functions and classes, package.json bin entries and scripts (scripts become script Units, never run). Dependencies from pyproject.toml, requirements files and package.json become dependency Units with their version constraints. Test files become check Units naming what they test. Also emit one knowledge Unit, the repository map: the top-level layout, languages by file count, entry points and where tests live, so a later reader can orient in one read. Tests in tests/test_digest_adapter_code.py build fixtures in tmp_path covering every case named here, prove determinism, bounded sizes and that malformed input yields an 'unparsed' Unit rather than an exception. You cannot run commands: the loop runs the listed checks after you report and returns any failure output, and the independent review returns its findings, to your next attempt. Do not report an owner decision for GitHub acceptance: it runs automatically after your candidate is published.
acceptance_criteria: Python is read with ast and JavaScript or TypeScript by pattern, never executed
capabilities, patterns, dependencies, scripts, checks and a repository map are produced
the adapter follows the shared contract: read-only, bounded, deterministic, never raising on malformed input
every listed check passes in the worker's workspace
